subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should model-call spans adopt the correct `CLIENT` classification now, accepting that existing dashboards filtering those spans as `INTERNAL` may need updates?
rationale: The code and OpenTelemetry contract support the correction, but changing an exported telemetry classification can intentionally alter existing operator queries and dashboards.

options.title: Accept the semantic correction
options.body: Refresh the branch, rerun required checks, and merge with the documented expectation that affected telemetry filters must include `CLIENT`.

options.title: Defer for compatibility planning
options.body: Pause the PR while maintainers decide whether existing `INTERNAL`-based dashboards need a transition or communication plan before changing the exported classification.

recommendation.title: Accept the semantic correction
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, rerun required checks, and merge with the documented expectation that affected telemetry filters must include `CLIENT`.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the affected GenAI tracing behavior and are the strongest history-based owner for accepting its telemetry compatibility change.
